title: Jack Sarfatti and physicists gather at Puharich's house

tellings.quote: just all sorts of Sarfattis, Jack Sarfatti being one of them. Like him and his kind of group of physicist people would go up there.

plain: In the 1970s the physicist Jack Sarfatti and a circle of fellow physicists used to visit the home of Andrija Puharich, a physician and researcher of psychic phenomena, in Ossining, New York. A guest on the show, a researcher who is not named, tells this in passing. It is told to show that serious scientists were drawn into Puharich's world of psychic and contact research.
